Work in /Users/marklevison/Documents/GitHub/expnese-tracker-attempts/yfl-expense-tracker-svelte-generated (SvelteKit 2 / Svelte 5 runes / Supabase / TS, vitest). NEVER run git commit. Code style: tabs, single quotes, no trailing commas, 100-char width. No `any` anywhere including tests. Do NOT edit docs/refactoring-backlog.md. No repo-wide prettier; at the end `npx prettier --write <touched files>` and `npx eslint <touched files>`, fixing eslint errors in files you touch (including pre-existing ones). Baseline right now: `npm run check` = 0 errors — it MUST still be 0 when you finish.

Read docs/refactoring-backlog.md entry RF-10 first.

Task 1 — RF-10: `ReconciliationService.convertToDisplayRows` and `sortDisplayRows` (src/lib/services/ReconciliationService.ts) transform domain `ReconciliationResult` into UI display rows and sort them — presentation leaking into the service layer. Move both to a presenter module, e.g. `src/lib/utils/reconciliationPresenter.ts`, as pure functions (they should need no service state — verify; if they touch instance state, extract that dependency as a param). Update the caller: src/routes/reconciliation/+page.svelte (2 call sites, `reconciliationService.convertToDisplayRows(result, sort)` — the page was just migrated to DI with `new ReconciliationService(supabase)`; keep that). Move the existing tests covering these two methods (search ReconciliationService.spec.ts and __tests__/ReconciliationService.test.ts) to a co-located `reconciliationPresenter.spec.ts` — move, don't duplicate or delete coverage. Types like `ReconciliationDisplayRow`/`MatchConfidence` live in src/lib/models/Reconciliation.ts — keep them there and import.

Task 2 — finish RF-09 on this page: src/routes/reconciliation/+page.svelte builds a category map with a hand-rolled loop (search for `categoryMap`). Replace it with `buildCategoryMap(rows, categories)` from `$lib/utils/resolveCategory` (just landed; read its API and the receipts page usage as the model). Also drop any now-unneeded `as Category[]` cast if the converged Category type makes it redundant.

Verification (must pass):
- `npx vitest run src/lib` → all green (~1569+ tests, 10 skipped is normal).
- `npm run check 2>&1 | tail -3` → **0 errors**.
- eslint + prettier on touched files.

Return: terse summary — presenter API, call sites updated, tests moved (counts), final check total, test counts.

- anthropic-skills:pptx: Use this skill any time a .pptx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". - verify: Verify that a code change actually does what it's supposed to by running the app and observing behavior. Use when asked to verify a PR, confirm a fix works, test a change manually, check that a feature works, or validate local changes before pushing.
- code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings). - simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs").
